svg.title: Retry with exponential backoff
svg.desc: Each retry waits twice as long as the last, giving a failing service room to recover. Delays are a fixed 1s, 2s, 4s doubling; each phase's timer is the wait after that failure, and phase lengths are stretched to hint at the growing gap (not to scale). Real clients add random jitter to each delay so retries from many clients don't arrive in sync, and give up (surfacing the error) after a maximum number of attempts. Only idempotent calls should be retried this way. 1. Normal calls: requests succeed on the first try. 2. Call fails: the service errors; wait 1s before retrying. 3. Retry 1 fails: the wait doubles to 2s. 4. Retry 2 fails: the wait doubles again to 4s. 5. Retry 3 succeeds: the service has recovered; the app gets its answer.
